name: Oreka
desc: Reusable infrastructure for markets where people trade on the outcome of future events.
detail: Binary prediction markets on the Internet Computer, with price-feed settlement, Internet Identity authentication, and a factory for deploying custom markets.
value: Useful for founders building prediction products who need market creation, identity, trading, and settlement connected in one application.
caption: Product interface · screenshot from the project repository

name: Chakra
desc: One swap interface. Multiple liquidity venues. A routing engine that finds and splits the trade.
detail: A Rust quote API and market-data worker maintain pool snapshots in Redis. The router combines multiple venue types, while Solidity contracts execute splits through Permit2 and a TypeScript SDK connects the frontend.
value: Relevant to trading teams that need a fast quote service, reliable blockchain indexing, wallet execution, and visibility into route health.
caption: Swap interface · captured from the live Arc testnet demo

name: Kamui
desc: Random results that applications can verify, rather than simply trust.
detail: An elliptic-curve verifiable random function implementation with a Rust cryptography library, CLI proof generation and verification, a Solana program, and a wallet-connected demonstration.
value: A foundation for games and protocols that need independently verifiable random outcomes and an integration path from proof generation to on-chain verification.
caption: VRF demo · captured from the live Solana devnet interface

name: FleetPay
desc: Send a payment to an email address, before the recipient has a wallet.
detail: An on-chain escrow lets recipients verify their email and claim to an Avalanche address. Pending funds can enter a capped yield vault; positive realized yield is shared on successful claims. Includes cancellation, expiry, and a fiat conversion preview.
value: Shows the full payment journey: onboarding, escrow state, recipient claims, and integration with external yield protocols.
caption: Payment interface · screenshot from the project repository

name: Haze API
desc: Prepaid API access with zero-knowledge proofs and a custom x402 integration.
detail: An invite-only pilot for private API credits. A local sidecar and versioned zk-prepaid adapter connect supported clients to a non-streaming chat API. Operational controls include readiness checks, durable pause state, and provider-spend caps.
value: Relevant to API and AI products that need client adapters, proof verification, billing state, and careful operational controls.
caption: API credits interface · captured from the public product site
